strings.איזה רגע ביום קשה לי קצת?: What moment in my day is a little hard?
strings.איך נוח לי לענות: לומר, להצביע או משהו א: How do I like answering: talking, pointing or another way?
strings.אין להחיל את המסלול על קבוצות גיל אחרות: Do not apply this pathway to other age groups without separate review.
strings.אין לכפות שם לבעיה או הסבר על מחשבות. הס: Do not impose a problem name or explanation of thoughts. Check developmentally appropriate child assent alongside guardian consent and professional duties; silence or completing a sheet does not consent to every action.
strings.אין שמירה אוטומטית ואין שליחה לרשת. השתמ: Nothing is saved automatically or sent over the network. Use fictional information for review. If an answer does not fit, shorten it or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Check print preview.
strings.אם הילד שותק, אפשר להכיר דרך פעילות מוכר: If silent, get acquainted through a familiar activity and return to the question another time. Avoiding writing is not resistance. Do not promise rewards for disclosure.
strings.אפשר להתחיל מתחום עניין ולבקש רשות לשאלה: Start with an interest and ask permission for the next question. Do not require independent reading or writing.
strings.בדקו מה עזר לילד לבטא בחירה, האם המלווה: Review what helped the child express choice, whether the supporter allowed their voice and what suitability questions remain before a treatment decision.
strings.בחרו בדף לאחר הערכה מקצועית ובהסכמה. אפש: Choose this sheet following professional assessment and with consent. The person may skip questions, answer aloud, or choose another tool. This is proposed original material for review; it provides no score, diagnosis, or promise of an outcome.
strings.בררו התפתחות, שפה, מסגרת, הסכמות וחובות: Explore development, language, setting, agreements and safeguarding duties. No approved treatment manual has been selected here; completion does not establish ERP readiness.
strings.גילי 6–7: להכיר, לשמוע את הילד ולבחור יח: Ages 6–7: getting acquainted, hearing the child and choosing together
strings.דוגמה בדויה: יואב בוחר לספר למטפלת על מש: Fictional example: Yoav tells the therapist about a favorite game. Asked what is hard, he points to leaving time. His mother records his words separately from her observations, and the therapist explores his preferred participation.
strings.דף P משותף לילד ולמלווה: שתי שאלות לקול: The P sheet is shared: two questions for the child's voice and three for supporter observations. Use only as agreed with the therapist, without child-alone exposure homework, abrupt response changes or punishment. Daily records and thought counts are unnecessary.
strings.המטפל או המלווה מקריא שאלה אחת. הילד יכו: The therapist or support person reads one question. The child may use a few words, point or skip. Adults may write the child's words but not answer for them. Professional terms and descriptions of every thought are not required.

strings.הקישורים הבאים שימשו לרקע בלבד. השאלות ו: The following links were used for background only. Questions and adaptations were written afresh for the expansion plan; no questionnaire, scale, or protocol was copied. Adult sources do not validate the child versions. This material makes no claim about session count or treatment effectiveness.

strings.טיוטה לסקירת מנהל. סקירה קלינית ואישור ז: Draft for administrator review. Clinical review and final rights approval are still pending.
strings.ילד בגילי 6–7 ומלווה מתאים: Child aged 6–7 and a suitable support person
strings.ילד ומלווה יחד, לפי סיכום עם המטפל. שתי: Child and support person together, as agreed with the therapist. Two child questions and three supporter questions. Spoken answers are welcome.
strings.ילד ומלווה, עם המטפל: Child and support person, with therapist
strings.ילד, מלווה ומטפל — תפקידים נפרדים: Child, support person and therapist — separate roles
strings.יש תשובה שחורגת משטח המילוי. הטופס לא הו: An answer exceeds the writing area. Printing was stopped to prevent silent clipping. Return to the screen, shorten the answer or save the complete answers as text and move them to a continuation page. Your entered text has not been deleted.
strings.לילד: מה היה לך נעים במפגש?: Child: What felt nice in the session?
strings.לילד: מה תרצה לומר בפעם הבאה?: Child: What would you like to say next time?
strings.ליצור היכרות עם שפה והעדפות של ילד בגילי: Learn the language and preferences of a child aged 6–7, explore participation and who can accompany them. The form establishes neither diagnosis nor full treatment consent.
strings.למלווה: איזו שאלת התאמה נביא למטפל?: Support person: What suitability question will we bring to the therapist?
strings.למלווה: כיצד הילד בחר להשתתף או לא להשתת: Support person: How did the child choose to participate or not?
strings.למלווה: מה הבחנת בלי לפרש את מחשבות הילד: Support person: What did you notice without interpreting the child's thoughts?
strings.לשיחה עם המטפל והמבוגר שמלווה אותי. אפשר: For talking with the therapist and my support adult. I can say a little, point or skip; the adult can write my words.
strings.מה אני רוצה שהמטפל ידע עליי?: What do I want the therapist to know about me?

strings.מסלול OCDYC נפרד מגילי 8 ומעלה. אין להסי: OCDYC is separate from ages 8 and over. Shortening an adult form does not establish suitability. This unit starts an adapted introduction; OCD-01 need not be completed first.

strings.סכמו מה הובן ומה נשאר פתוח. היעזרו ב־SES: Summarize what became clearer and what remains open. Use the existing SES-S01 and SES-S02 for the session framework. There is no need to repeat an assessment or plan already recorded.

strings.קיימת רשומת סקירה נפרדת לכל גרסה: התאמת: Each version has a separate review record covering age suitability, originality, rights, and fictional filling. Reviewer and date fields remain blank until assigned. File checks or a code merge are not clinical approval. Clinical information stays only in the authorized setting, outside the code repository.
strings.תארו את מטרת הפנייה בשפה שאינה מאשימה. ס: Describe the reason for seeking help without blame. Clearly separate the child's words from your observations.
